tools.name: record_entry
tools.description: Unified write tool: record a decision, constraint, or pipeline. Required fields by kind (validated server-side): decision needs summary/problem/why_chosen; constraint needs rule/reason; pipeline needs name/purpose/steps.

kind.description: Which kind of entry to record.

problem.description: decision: what forced it. Min 40 chars.

tradeoffs.description: decision: what was given up. Encouraged.

alternatives.description: decision: options considered and why rejected.

supersedes.description: decision: ids of prior decisions this replaces.

reason.description: constraint: why it exists. Min 40 chars.

enforced_by.description: constraint: test/command that checks it (named, never run).

purpose.description: pipeline: why it exists. Min 40 chars.

related_to.description: ids of related entries; get_context traverses these.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the target project. Creates .context/ if needed.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Retrieve relevant project context ranked by relevance within a token budget. Pass an id to fetch a single entry at full fidelity.

id.description: Fetch a single entry by ID (e.g. 'dec-001')

query.description: Free-text description of what you're working on

tags.description: Filter to entries with any of these tags

scope.description: File or module path to focus on

token_budget.description: Max tokens to return (default: from config)

types.description: Limit to specific entry types. Default: all.

since.description: Entries verified/created on or after this ISO date.

before.description: Entries verified/created strictly before this ISO date.

include_related.description: Also pull entries linked via related_to (depth 1). Default: true.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to another project to read context from

tools.name: query_entries
tools.description: Structured field filter — exact AND-combined predicates, NOT relevance search. Use when you know the field values (e.g. absolute constraints scoped to 'hooks/'). Stable ID order, no ranking; empty is a real answer. Includes superseded/deprecated unless you filter status.

types.description: Restrict to these entry types. Default: all.

kind.description: Singular alias for `types`. `types` wins if both given.

text.description: Free text over text fields; every term must appear (AND, substring).

limit.description: Cap entries returned (matched_entries reports the total).

origin.description: user/agent/import (string or list). Missing counts as 'agent'.

tags_any.description: Entries with AT LEAST ONE of these tags.

tags_all.description: Entries with ALL of these tags.

scope.description: Exact, case-sensitive match on a constraint's scope (e.g. 'hooks/').

supersedes.description: The entry that superseded this id.

superseded_by.description: Entries replaced by this id (superseded_by == id).

since.description: Verified/created on or after this ISO date.

before.description: Verified/created strictly before this ISO date.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to another project to query.

tools.name: get_project_summary
tools.description: The single orienting call for conversation start: counts by kind and status, active constraints (compact), recent decisions, the full id list, and the human-readable summary — all in one response.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to another project to summarize

tools.name: update_entry
tools.description: Update an existing decision, pipeline, or constraint by ID. Refreshes verified_at timestamp automatically.

updates.description: Fields to update. Any field except id and created_at.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to another project whose entry should be updated

tools.name: deprecate_entry
tools.description: Mark an entry as deprecated. For decisions, optionally link to the superseding decision.

superseded_by.description: ID of the replacing decision (decisions only)

merge_into.description: Dedup merge: fold this entry's unique content into this same-type target, then deprecate this one with superseded_by=target. Non-destructive — the target is only added to.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to another project whose entry should be deprecated

tools.name: prune_stale
tools.description: Find entries not verified in N days. Returns them for review — does not delete. Call periodically to keep context fresh.

days.description: Entries not verified in this many days are flagged (default: from config)

project_dir.description: Absolute path to another project to prune

tools.name: get_compaction_report
tools.description: Check if the last compaction lost or modified any context entries. Surface discrepancies to the user before proceeding.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to another project to check

tools.name: verify_quality
tools.description: Scan entries for quality issues (legacy schema, thin reasoning, missing tags, isolated entries) and return them for enrichment via update_entry.

min_reason_chars.description: Below this length, flag the entry as thin (default: 80)

project_dir.description: Absolute path to another project to verify

tools.name: export_markdown
tools.description: Regenerate DECISIONS.md from the decisions store — a derived, read-only projection; overwrites the file whole.

path.description: Output path relative to project root. Default: config markdown_export.path.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the target project.

tools.name: reload_constraints
tools.description: Re-surface the project's constraints only (not the full store) when a long session has buried the ones injected at start. Same block as session start.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the target project.

tools.name: export_snapshot
tools.description: Write the whole store to a compressed, committable snapshot at .context-keeper/memory.json.gz (next to the project) and add a .gitattributes merge=ours guard. For sharing project memory with a team via git. Committing it is opt-in. Non-destructive to the working store.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the target project.

tools.name: import_snapshot
tools.description: Import the committed .context-keeper/memory.json.gz snapshot into the working store. Non-destructive: a store that already has entries is left untouched. Runs automatically on first use when the store is empty.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the target project.

tools.name: mirror
tools.description: Sync entries with the remote store. op='pull' merges remote entries into local (newest wins); op='backfill' pushes all local entries to remote (upsert). No-op if remote unconfigured.

op.description: pull = remote→local merge; backfill = local→remote push.
